title: Trump to Attend TSMC Groundbreaking Ceremony in Arizona
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

President Donald Trump is scheduled to attend TSMC's upcoming groundbreaking ceremony in Arizona, highlighting the growing importance of semiconductor manufacturing to the United States’ economic and technological strategy.

Both the White House and TSMC have confirmed the president’s planned participation. Trump is expected to deliver remarks commemorating the construction of a new semiconductor manufacturing facility as part of the Taiwanese chipmaker’s ambitious American expansion.

The ceremony follows TSMC’s announcement of an additional $100 billion investment in Arizona in July 2026, bringing its total announced U.S. investment to $265 billion. The expansion includes additional semiconductor fabrication plants and advanced chip packaging facilities, strengthening the domestic semiconductor supply chain.

Trump’s attendance underscores his administration’s commitment to bringing advanced manufacturing back to the United States, reducing dependence on overseas semiconductor production and strengthening American technological competitiveness.

TSMC’s Arizona operations are particularly significant for the rapidly growing artificial intelligence industry. The company manufactures advanced chips for major technology companies, including Nvidia, Apple, AMD, Broadcom and Qualcomm. Expanding domestic production could help meet increasing demand for high-performance computing and AI infrastructure.

The investment is also expected to generate substantial economic benefits for Arizona, including construction jobs, permanent engineering and manufacturing positions, and additional business opportunities for semiconductor equipment and materials suppliers.

The groundbreaking ceremony represents another milestone in TSMC’s long-term commitment to American manufacturing and the broader effort to establish the United States as a global semiconductor production hub.

For Trump, the event offers an opportunity to showcase foreign investment, domestic job creation and progress toward his administration’s industrial policy objectives. For TSMC, it reinforces its strategic position as a critical partner in America’s technological and economic future.
